gate_note: C1/C2/C3 remain held. Gate: ≥1-week Phase A convention conformance. C4 activated early per user approval — lowest-risk collapse (notebooks pre-exist, sessions/ is append-only, no coordination surface, rollback is lossless).

tasks.description: Append notebook commit variant as a no-trailer section. Format: chore(memory/<agent-id>): notebook YYYY-MM-DD. Clarify: no Sprint/Task/AC trailers required — memory update, not task completion.

Replace every 'append session log' / 'write session log' step with a 'commit notebook' step. Commit format: chore(memory/<agent-id>): notebook YYYY-MM-DD. Step must be at end-of-cycle position (mandatory, not optional). Agent IDs must match the notebook filenames under docs/agent-memory/notebooks/.

Fold the latest content from each agent's session log into its notebook. Source: docs/agent-memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-<agent>.md (use most recent date per agent). Only additive — do not overwrite existing notebook content, append/merge new info. After fold, each notebook must be committed with chore(memory/<agent-id>): notebook 2026-05-10.
Delete the entire sessions/ directory. Must execute only after B9 fold + commits are done. Verify zero remaining unique content before deletion.
